name: Teralite
imageAlt: Teralite website shown on a desktop display
body: With over 60 years in the industrial flooring industry, Teralite is a name that carries serious weight. But their old digital presence didn’t reflect their legacy — or their innovation. That’s where we came in.

We partnered with Teralite to modernize their website, streamline their messaging, and create a user experience that matched the quality of their work. Now featuring a clean, responsive design and optimized performance, the new site showcases their proprietary systems and nationwide reach — from California to Hawaii and Washington.

This updated digital platform has helped position them as a forward-thinking leader in resinous and epoxy flooring, attracting more high-quality leads and reinforcing trust with both longtime and new clients.
result: Traffic increased by 56% in the first 60 days.
